name: hoffmann-2021-violence.pdf
description: Reassessment of the Late Pleistocene Jebel Sahaba Nile Valley cemetery (~13.4 ka, 61 individuals) using microscopic lesion analysis, documenting 106 new lesions, 52 projectile impact marks, and embedded Qadan lithics as evidence of recurrent interpersonal violence, compared with Nataruk and Wadi Halfa.
